visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female dermatologist, Dr. Liu, with short dark hair and glasses, is seen from the chest up in a well-lit clinic office. She wears a beige crochet-patterned top over a dark shirt. Behind her are medical certificates and clinic equipment. She speaks enthusiastically with active facial expressions and mouth movements. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a male patient's forehead under a bright diagnostic ring light. The skin texture, highlighting visible pores and minor oily patches, is the central focus. A hand enters the frame briefly to adjust the lighting angle to better reveal the skin condition. (3) Dr. Liu continues her consultation, using expressive hand gestures to emphasize points about skin roughness. A reference photo of a clear-skinned man in a suit is overlaid on the screen as a goal example. The background remains the tidy, brightly lit professional dermatology office. (4) A digital skin analysis interface is shown, featuring a macro view of a nose with numerous red fluorescent dots indicating bacteria and sebum levels. This is followed by Dr. Liu showing a photo on her smartphone of a face covered in blood spots after an aggressive laser treatment. (5) A medical procedure is shown in close-up: a white and blue medical device called 'Multiflex' is applied to the patient's forehead by a hand in a blue glove. Red laser light flashes rhythmically against the skin, which exhibits mild redness. The device screen shows technical power settings. (6) The video concludes with a clean white graphic background featuring the clinic's brand logo, social media handles, telephone numbers, and two physical addresses in Traditional Chinese characters. The overall presentation is professional and follows a standard health-promotion layout.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a professional clinical showcase and promotional advertisement for 'Multiflex' laser skin treatment at DRX Dermatology Clinic. By identifying common aesthetic concerns for men, such as large pores and oily skin texture, the dermatologist uses diagnostic evidence and a contrast between aggressive and mild treatments to persuade viewers of the safety and efficacy of their specific medical service.
